behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer; the window reads byte [rdi+0x1f2] and writes byte [rdi+0x1f3]
behavior.branch_order: no branches: sete feeds a times-three lea, then a constant add; both input classes flow through the same five instructions
behavior.output_shape: byte [rdi+0x1f3] is set to 0x5a when byte [rdi+0x1f2] is 0, else 0x57; eax returns the same value (full register, no low-byte caveat)
behavior.rule: [rdi+0x1f3] = (byte [rdi+0x1f2] == 0 ? 0x5a : 0x57); return value equals the stored byte

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

data_edge.pointer_table_note: ten R_X86_64_RELATIVE slots in .data.rel.ro name this window as addend; they form a pointer table (one function pointer per table entry at offset 0x30), not a single naming relocation, and the table's purpose is not claimed
